title: Count Pairs With Sum Divisible by K
description: Count index pairs `(i, j)` with `i < j` such that `nums[i] + nums[j]` is divisible by positive integer `k`. Input: non-negative array `nums` and `k`. Output: the exact pair count.
hints: Track the running prefix, window, or frequency information needed by the condition.
Check duplicates, all-equal values, and boundary-sized windows.
